nodes.description: Private mapping tracking how many times each address has sold/transferred tokens, used by condition() to cap sales.
Private mapping marking addresses that are whitelisted to bypass the sale restrictions in ensure().
Private lower bound on transfer value enforced by condition().
Private upper bound on transfer value enforced by condition().
Private maximum number of sells allowed per address, checked in condition().
Address that is exempted from sale restrictions; settable by owner via transferownership().
Public mapping of token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom().
Public nested mapping of spending allowances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom() and approve().
Constant token decimals (18) used for scaling supply and bonus amounts.
Public total token supply set once in the constructor.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Private owner address; controls approveAndCall() and transferownership(), checked in ensure().
Public payable transfer() that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate: allows transfers if sender/recipient is owner, tradeAddress, or whitelisted; otherwise defers to condition().
Public payable transferFrom() that mutates allowance, balances and _onSaleNum using unchecked arithmetic before emitting Transfer.
Public payable approve() that writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender and emits Approval.
Internal view that enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits per sender.
Owner-only function that mints arbitrary balance to a spender and whitelists it in canSale, acting as a privileged mint/backdoor.
Owner-only function that assigns tradeAddress, effectively changing who is exempt from sale restrictions.
Payable constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply (unchecked multiplication), owner and initial balance.
msg.sender inside transferFrom(), controlling allowance spend and the ensure()/condition() checks.
msg.sender inside approve(), used as the allowance owner key.
msg.sender inside approveAndCall(), required to equal owner.
msg.sender inside transferownership(), required to equal owner.
msg.sender inside the constructor, which becomes the owner and receives the whole supply.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath in transferFrom().
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath in transferFrom().
balanceOf[_to] += _value / balanceOf[spender] assignment performed without SafeMath.
totalSupply = _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) computed without SafeMath overflow protection.
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) unconditional owner-controlled minting without SafeMath.
tradeAddress = addr lets the owner whitelist an arbitrary address to bypass sale restrictions.
canSale[spender]=true permanently whitelists an arbitrary address.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Sender address parameter of ensure().
Recipient address parameter of ensure().
Amount parameter of ensure(), forwarded to condition().
Source address parameter of transferFrom().
Destination address parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom().
Spender address parameter of approve().
Allowance amount parameter of approve().
Sender address parameter of condition(), indexed into _onSaleNum.
Amount parameter of condition(), compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
Spender address parameter of approveAndCall(), receives minted balance and whitelist flag.
Added value parameter of approveAndCall(), multiplied by 10**decimals to mint balance.
New tradeAddress parameter of transferownership().
Token name parameter of the constructor.
Token symbol parameter of the constructor.
Initial supply parameter of the constructor, scaled by 10**decimals.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller of transferFrom() and drives allowance spending and ensure() checks for the attacker-controlled address.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve(), letting any caller grant arbitrary approvals over its own balance.
msg.sender must equal owner in approveAndCall(); the privileged mint path is gated by caller identity.
msg.sender must equal owner in transferownership(); caller identity decides who can set tradeAddress.
msg.sender is assigned as owner in the constructor and receives the entire initial supply.
transfer() immediately delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() via require() and reverts if the gate fails.
ensure() calls condition() when the sender is not owner, tradeAddress or a canSale address.
_value flows into the unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom().
_value flows into the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom().
_value flows into the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom().
transferFrom() reads and decrements the allowance mapping for the caller.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] to count sells per address.
ensure() compares _from and _to against tradeAddress to bypass restrictions.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to whitelist addresses beyond the sale rules.
ensure() grants unrestricted transfers when either party is owner.
condition() reads _saleNum to limit the number of sells per address.
condition() compares _minSale against the transfer value.
condition() compares the transfer value against _maxSale.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sell cap.
approveAndCall() writes balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) without overflow protection.
approveAndCall() sets canSale[spender]=true, permanently whitelisting an arbitrary address.
transferownership() writes an arbitrary addr into tradeAddress, changing the restriction bypass set.
The constructor computes totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals) without SafeMath overflow checks.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender, assigning all privileged rights to the deployer.
approve() writes the nested allowance mapping keyed by msg.sender and _spender.
transfer() forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom().
_to is forwarded by transfer() to transferFrom().
_value is forwarded by transfer() to transferFrom().
_from drives the owner/tradeAddress/canSale checks inside ensure().
_to drives the owner check inside ensure().
_value is passed from ensure() into condition().
_from key indexes allowance and balanceOf and is the source of the debit in transferFrom().
_to is the destination of the balance credit in transferFrom().
_value is the amount debited/credited in transferFrom().
_spender is the allowance key written by approve().
_value is the allowance amount written by approve().
_from indexes _onSaleNum when condition() enforces the sell cap.
_value is compared against _minSale/_maxSale in condition().
spender is credited with minted balance and whitelisted in approveAndCall().
addedValue determines the minted amount in approveAndCall().
addr becomes the new tradeAddress set by transferownership().
_name is stored as the token name in the constructor.
_symbol is stored as the token symbol in the constructor.
_supply is scaled and stored as totalSupply in the constructor.
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals inside the unchecked mint computation.
_supply is multiplied by 10**decimals inside the unchecked totalSupply computation.
msg.sender indexes the allowance entry that is decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom().
msg.sender flows as _from into ensure(), deciding which restriction path is taken.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to belongs only to transfer(); it is forwarded to transferFrom().
Parameter _value belongs only to transfer(); it is forwarded to transferFrom().
Parameter _from is the address evaluated by ensure() against owner/tradeAddress/canSale.
Parameter _to is the recipient address evaluated by ensure() against owner.
Parameter _value is forwarded by ensure() into condition() for range checks.
Parameter _from is the debit key for allowance and balanceOf inside transferFrom().
Parameter _to is the credit key for balanceOf inside transferFrom().
Parameter _value is the amount mutated by transferFrom().
Parameter _spender is the allowance key written by approve().
Parameter _value is the allowance amount written by approve().
Parameter _value is compared to _minSale/_maxSale inside condition().
Parameter spender receives the minted balance and whitelist flag in approveAndCall().
Parameter addedValue is multiplied and assigned to balanceOf[spender] in approveAndCall().
Parameter addr is stored into tradeAddress by transferownership().
Parameter _name is stored into the name state variable by the constructor.
Parameter _symbol is stored into the symbol state variable by the constructor.
Parameter _supply is scaled into totalSupply by the constructor.
